title: Mamba-3VL: Taming State Space Model for 3D Vision Language Learning
caption: Figure 3. Preliminaries on pipeline of the proposed Mamba-3VL. (a) Our Mamba-3VL is a query-based decoding framework composed of stacked Mamba Mixer and IDPA layers. (b) Mamba Mixer with the interleaved (d) channel twisting mechanism and (e) relation-prioritized spatial scanning policy. (c) IDPA dynamically adjusts instance-aware positional embeddings via a geometric-semantic warping.
